name: What metrics should cosmetic surgeons track to measure AEO success?

mainEntity.name: What metrics should cosmetic surgeons track to measure AEO success?

acceptedAnswer.text: To measure AEO success, cosmetic surgeons should track metrics beyond just website traffic. Key indicators include direct answer impressions (how often your content appears as a featured snippet or direct answer), click-through rates from these snippets, increases in organic search visibility for specific questions, and improvements in voice search performance. Additionally, monitor conversions stemming from AEO-optimized content, such as consultation requests or form submissions. Tools like Google Search Console and analytics platforms can provide valuable insights into these metrics, helping you understand content effectiveness.
acceptedAnswer.description: Track direct answer impressions, click-through rates from snippets, organic visibility for specific questions, voice search performance, and conversions like consultation requests.
